name: Sinopec
description: China Petrochemical Corporation: Asia's largest refiner and a top ethylene producer, operating refining-petrochemical complexes (mega-tonne crackers, crude-to-chemicals refineries) and the Kuqa green-hydrogen plant powered by PERIC alkaline electrolysers. Licenses its own refining and petrochemical technologies (catalog source sinopec-tech). Parent of Sinopec Engineering Group, its EPC and licensing arm.
